title: Singing River Tours
specs: Original music by professional musician and entertainer Jon Semmes
includes: Guide sharing knowledge of ecology and history through story and song
blurb: Tours last about an hour and forty minutes on a comfortable, covered 40' pontoon boat. The guide shares knowledge of Florida's ecology and history through story and song. Tours depart from Dunnellon City Boat Ramp and are handicap-accessible.
extraNote: Dunnellon City Boat Ramp located at 20750 River Drive, Dunnellon, FL 34431
